projects.name: IDOT Multi-Year Improvement Program - Roadway FY 2027-2031
projects.notes: IDOT's published FY 2026-2031 Multi-Year Program (Publicatio = '20262031MULTI-YEAR SQ'), hosted on IDOT's ArcGIS Online account despite the service name 'MYP_Test'. All planned. Layers: 0 Structure FY 2026 (point, 953), 1 Structure FY 2027-2031 (point, 1682), 2 Spot FY 2026 (point, 425), 3 Spot FY 2027-2031 (point, 1093), 4 Roadway FY 2026 (polyline, 660), 5 Roadway FY 2027-2031 (polyline, 1734). The FY 2026 layers are the current annual program (soonest to construction). No letting date: ProgramYea is the year within the program (2-6 here). Improvem_1..Improve_11 hold up to 11 improvement types; ProjectTam is the asset-management category; EstimatedC is text with commas. County1..County4.

projects.name: IDOT Multi-Year Improvement Program - Structure FY 2027-2031
projects.notes: Bridge/structure projects of the same program; fewer attributes than the roadway layer (no county field). Sample Improvem_1: 'Bridge Replacement'.

parcels_statewide_note: No free statewide parcel layer with owner names was found for Illinois.

parcels_counties.notes: DuPage County server. BILLNAME is the tax-bill name (taxpayer); PROPNAME is also a name field; MAJOR_PROPERTY_OWNER is filled only for large holders. Text fields are space-padded.
Lake County open-data parcel polygons. Name is the taxpayer of record. No value or acreage fields.

parcels_counties_note: Not found or not reachable in the time allowed: Cook (no owner or taxpayer name in any public GIS layer found; gis.cookcountyil.gov timed out; only a 2016 south-suburbs extract with taxpayer names exists on ArcGIS Online), Will (gis.willcountyillinois.com answered 403), Kane (public parcel layer has no owner field).
summary: Projects: IDOT Multi-Year Program FY 2026-2031 verified as six ArcGIS Online layers (roadway lines, structure and spot points) with improvement type and cost but no letting date. Parcels: no statewide owner layer; DuPage and Lake verified with taxpayer names; Cook, Will and Kane have no usable owner layer.
